device.description: 18-bit 1 MSPS fully differential SAR ADC with integrated reference buffer and LDO, enhanced-SPI interface (ADS8910B)
device.note: ads8910b.pdf (SBAS707B) p.4-5 pin functions, p.6 recommended operating conditions, p.9 timing requirements, p.10 switching characteristics, p.23 transfer function (twos complement), p.25-26 RST/ACQ/CNV states, p.27 commands (Table 2), p.27-29 output data word and parity, p.30-31 data transfer frame, p.37-38 SPI protocols (Tables 4-5), p.51-56 register map

commands.note: p.27 Table 2; PD_CNTL: setting PD_ADC powers the converter down at the CS rising edge

commands.name: WR_REG (PD_CNTL, PD_ADC = 0)
commands.note: p.27 Table 2; PD_CNTL: clearing PD_ADC powers the converter up

commands.note: p.27 Table 2; p.27-28 output data word, Figure 41: D[21:14] of the next frame are the register, D[13:0] zeros

pages: p.4-5 (pins), p.6 (ROC: DVDD 1.65-5.5 V), p.9-10 (timing), p.23 (transfer function), p.25-26 (device states), p.27-29 (commands, output data word), p.30-31 (frame), p.37-38 (SPI protocols), p.51-56 (registers)
notModeled: analog input, reference input, reference buffer and LDO; the result is always the 0 V differential code 00000h (twos complement)
22-bit command word decoded from the last 22 SDI bits before CS rises (align end); frames shorter than 22 SCLKs are NOPs (p.30-31 data transfer frame)

SPI protocol selection: SDI_MODE (SPI-01/10/11) and SDO_MODE early data launch / source-synchronous output, SDO_WIDTH dual/quad SDO, DATA_RATE (DDR), SSYNC_CLK_SEL with RVS as strobe: stored only; the bus stays SPI-00-S on SDO-0 (SDO-1..3 never driven)
parity bits FLPAR/FTPAR (PAR_EN, FPAR_LOC): stored only; the parity positions output 0, which is correct for the 0 V code but not for register read-back or nonzero test patterns

PD_ADC power-down is modeled only for WR_REG to PD_CNTL (SET_BITS/CLR_BITS on PD_CNTL change the bit without powering down); PD_REFBUF, power-up times tPU_ADC / tPU_REFBUF, RST-to-RVS delay td_rst 3 ms
RVS while CS is low (low from CS fall, then per output protocol) and the td_CSRDY_r delay after CS rise: not modeled; RVS is low while converting
offset calibration (REF_SEL) and reference margining (EN_MARG, REF_OFST): stored only
conversion time varies 580-640 ns (modeled: tconv max 640 ns); cycle time, acquisition and quiet-zone timing, SCLK frequency limits
reserved command codes: treated as NOP (unmatched)
variants: ads8910b.pdf covers ADS8910B (1 MSPS, tconv 640 ns), ADS8912B (500 kSPS, 1200 ns) and ADS8914B (250 kSPS, 2500 ns): same pinout, registers and protocol; only the conversion time differs.
